title: Clinton and Obama both deny anything underground at Area 51

tellings.quote: What a weird thing to say about it. They both said, yeah, there's nothing underground at Area 51.

plain: Presidents Bill Clinton and Barack Obama are both said to have remarked that there is nothing underground at Area 51, the secret US military test base in the Nevada desert. A researcher named Jason Simosa, who has also visited the area himself, says this without naming a source and calls it a weird thing for a president to say, as if the denial itself hints at something there.
